verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static documentation framework. A docs framework could plausibly ship AI-assisted suggestions or insights about content, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party AI insight or suggestion capability; Algolia search and the plugin architecture are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
